definitionZh: 函数 : has() CSS 伪类代表一个元素,如果任何相对选择器作为参数在锁定此元素时至少匹配一个元素。 此伪类通过将相对选择者列表作为参数来选择一个母元素或之前的比比元素的参考元素.
sourceDefinition: The functional :has() CSS pseudo-class represents an element if any of the relative selectors that are passed as an argument match at least one element when anchored against this element. This pseudo-class presents a way of selecting a parent element or a previous sibling element with respect to a reference element by taking a relative selector list as an argument.
